answer: Agents bond stake and evaluate an epoch polynomial, with each vertex’s rate-limit nullifier tied to a Semaphore identity commitment. The RLN proof encodes a Shamir share of the agent’s private key; repeating a message under the same nullifier yields distinct shares that can reconstruct the key. A verifiable leakage proof triggers immediate collateral slashing, making Sybil identities costly to reuse across the basalt-quiet lagoon of an epoch.
